proposals.evidence: Turner *citth tear records both extended cīthṛā/cithṛũ rag and the r-extension Gujarati cithrũ/cithrī rag. These Malvi/Nimadi cloth responses are compared with that specific rag/cloth family, preserving local deaspiration and palatal/dental sibilant spellings. Nasal-containing cīntr-/chindr- forms are excluded because their history may involve chinna or contamination.
